limits: 100-person mean gain limited to serial correctness control; not mixed-load or fullcapacity acceptance. Phase samples biased/shared <=8/s, cannot sum differentphase mean into a critical path; capture clocks user-space. For group peer-only arrival-minus-task-finish is useful boundary, ACK finish happens after arrival. No service root cause assumed from counters alone.
